description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Atsushi, adding {C}{C}.
Atsushi dies, triggering itself and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Atsushi trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve Enduring Renewal's trigger, returning Atsushi from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Atsushi from your hand by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
